messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 11):
"""
Covering its approach and aspects relating to offering health insurance coverage across all ages and medical conditions in line with Para 1 of Chapter I. b. That ensure Ayush treatments at par with the other treatments so as to provide option to the policyholders to choose treatment of their choice. (2) Have in place board approved policy on quality standards and benchmarks for empanelment of Hospitals and Health Care Providers: a. striving to provide 100% cashless services to the policyholders. The said policy should enable empanelment of all categories of hospitals considering the affordability of different segments of population b. for every situation of treatment including domiciliary hospitalization, outpatient treatment (OPD), Day Care and Homecare treatment; (3) Proposal Forms/ Customer Information Sheet (CIS) a.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What type of treatment options must IRDAI-approved health insurers provide to policyholders according to the circular?","answer":"Insurers must offer Ayush treatments alongside other treatments, giving policyholders the option to choose their preferred treatment.","facts":["\"ensure Ayush treatments at par with the other treatments\"","\"provide option to the policyholders to choose treatment of their choice\""]},{"question":"What service coverage must be available for all categories of hospitals under the IRDAI circular?","answer":"Insurers must provide 100% cashless services for all categories of hospitals, covering domiciliary hospitalization, outpatient treatment (OPD), Day Care and Homecare treatment.","facts":["\"striving to provide 100% cashless services to the policyholders\"","\"for every situation of treatment including domiciliary hospitalization, outpatient treatment (OPD), Day Care and Homecare treatment\""]}]}
